meta.note: Trees as [x, z, kind, surveyed] (surveyed 1 = a DataSF Street Tree List tree or an OpenStreetMap natural=tree, 0 = synthesised). kind: palm = Canary Island date palms and fan palms (the Embarcadero median and promenade, King St by the ballpark, Market St's east end, Union Square: 12-18 m, thick trunk, big crown; synthesised every 25 m along The Embarcadero and King St where the surveys map none); plane = London plane (Platanus: Market St, the pollarded planes of Civic Center); street = other street trees (ficus, Brisbane box, flowering pear and plum, New Zealand Christmas tree, ginkgo: 6-12 m, rounded, in sidewalk pits); evergreen = Monterey cypress and pine, redwoods (parks, Telegraph Hill, Aquatic Park: dark, wind-shaped); park = mixed park trees (synthesised on a jittered grid in woods and round the edges of lawns where OSM maps none). Trees closer than 1 u to another, in water, inside building footprints or inside the ring venue box (ring.ringClearTrees in sf_layout.json) are left out; street trees are thinned at random to keep the file under about 11,000.
